bio.text: Charles Hoelter is the Republican candidate for California's 15th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Kevin Mullin.
Hoelter graduated from Lincoln High School and earned a bachelor's degree from San Francisco State University in 1989.

In a Ballotpedia candidate survey response, Hoelter described being a retired UPS supervisor with more than 25 years at the company, having lived in San Francisco for 27 years before moving to San Mateo County, and being married with three children.
